channel.title: Business Insider Africa - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Africa (africa.businessinsider.com)

item.title: Russian intelligence claims France has approved the removal of ‘unwanted leaders’ in Africa
item.description: The Russian Foreign Intelligence Service (SVR) recently alleged that France’s president, Emmanuel Macron, has approved his special services to launch a plan to remove "unwanted leaders" in Africa.

item.title: China to help Algeria reopen its Gara Djebilet mine, North Africa’s largest iron ore deposi
item.description: Algeria has turned to China to reopen Gara Djebilet, the largest iron ore deposit in North Africa, marking a significant step in the country’s push to diversify its economy and expand its mining sector.

item.title: Dangote refinery secures new NNPC gas deals to power expansion plans to woo US, UK, other markets
item.description: Dangote Group has expanded its gas supply agreements with units of the Nigerian National Petroleum Company Limited (NNPCL), strengthening energy security for its refinery, fertiliser, and cement operations as Nigeria accelerates plans to position gas as a central pillar of economic growth and attract foreign patronage.

item.title: Top 10 African countries with the largest active military manpower at the start of 2026
item.description: In Africa, military strength is often measured not just by weapons or spending, but by people. Ethiopia has Africa’s largest military by personnel, ranking 9th globally with about 503,000 active troops.

item.title: Canadian gold and silver miner to invest $60 million in Morocco amid volatile precious metal prices
item.description: Canadian gold and silver miner said it will invest roughly $60 million in 2026 to expand exploration at its Zgounder and Boumadine projects in Morocco, as precious metal prices experience volatility following earlier surges.

item.title: Meet the investor: Florent Nduwayezu on backing African startups through FP Capital’s $10 million fund
item.description: Florent Nduwayezu believes execution beats ideas every time. He invests in African founders who move fast, pivot wisely, and bring in paying customers. Through FP Capital, a $10 million venture firm, he is helping high-growth startups scale across Africa and redefine what returns in African markets look like.

item.title: Canadian miner Zodiac Gold to spend $6.1 million on Liberia gold mine exploration
item.description: Canadian gold exploration company Zodiac Gold Inc. has launched its 2026 exploration program in Liberia at the Todi Gold Project, committing $6.1 million to drilling and trenching at the Ben Ben target.

item.title: The U.S. says it is simply protecting itself by launching attacks on Somali soil
item.description: Towards the end of the previous month, the United States launched an airstrike in Somalia, targeting ISIS, the same terrorist group it launched an offensive on in Nigeria.

item.title: Africans abroad have been temporarily suspended from becoming Ghanaian citizens
item.description: The Ghanaian program, initiated to give Africans in diaspora a place to call home, has been temporarily put on hold.

item.title: Nigeria signs deal with South Korea to launch Africa’s first electric vehicle factory
item.description: Nigeria has taken a major step toward establishing a domestic electric vehicle (EV) industry after signing an agreement with South Korea’s Asia Economic Development Committee (AEDC) to establish what officials are calling Africa’s first EV manufacturing plant.
